title: On Surjective Max-Phase Isometries of Schatten p-Classes (0<p<1)
summary: We investigate max-phase isometries on Schatten quasi-classes in the range $0<p<1$. Motivated by the rigidity theory for smooth normed spaces [\emph{Results Math.} \textbf{80} (2025), Article 126], we establish its operator-theoretic counterpart in the quasi-Banach setting. We prove that every surjective max-phase isometry on a finite-dimensional Schatten class is a standard real-linear Schatten isometry multiplied by an even sign-valued function, without any continuity assumption.
